builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess, no JVM tool
builder.reason: The mutation is one code-unit patch inside a reviewed baseline; a source compiler cannot produce a branch into the operand word of a multiword const.

decode: units 0..2: const v0, 7 (31i, three words: opcode word 0x0014, literal words 0x0007 0x0000)
unit 3: goto -3 (10t, target unit 0, the const opcode word)
unit 4: return v0 (11x, unreachable but format-valid)
originalInput.note: The baseline loop is unbounded, so no execution oracle is claimed for it.

mutation.intendedChange: goto delta -3 -> -2, so the branch target moves from unit 0 (the 31i const opcode word) to unit 1, which is the first literal word of that three-word const and therefore not an instruction boundary
mutation.unchanged: file_size, header, tables, refs, declaration, version, code range and the remaining three code units
mutation.rehash: header checksum at 0x08..0x0b and signature at 0x0c..0x1f recomputed over the mutated bytes; together with the one patched byte at 0x167 these are the only 25 changed offsets
mutation.note_on_offsets: the goto code unit stored at file offset 0x166 is 0xfd28; 10t keeps its signed 8-bit delta in the high byte, so only the high byte at 0x167 changes 0xfd -> 0xfe and the low byte 0x28 stays identical

certificationObligations: An independent decoder proves the mutated branch target is code unit 1, which is the operand word of the 21s const/16 at units 0..1, and not an instruction boundary.
An independent decoder confirms every other field of the mutated file equals the baseline: same five code units except the patched word, same declaration, same version, same empty reference tables.
The fault certificate records the anchor file offset, the original and mutated code units and both SHA-256 values; no second malformed field is introduced.
gaps: The independent dexlib2 projection is not executable in this worktree; B03 owns that step and confirms the same anchors against the locked decoder.
The engine rejection itself is not observed here.
